verdict.rationale: Formant documents the data-out half: data scientists can query and export telemetry through the Python Cloud SDK, and time-synced video, sensor and intervention records are available. Nothing documents a training pipeline or model deployment to the fleet. Pushing a model back could only be improvised with custom commands that run scripts, or with webhooks. Missing for 10: any native model-training integration or dataset curation workflow, documented model/artifact deployment or OTA rollout to devices, versioning or rollback of deployed models, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a train-and-redeploy loop.
